name: 💀Shrek in The Backrooms
desc:
Teleport to 30+ levels, discover new entities, and hidden items!

Find your way through the never ending maze of wallpaper and buzzing lights to find the exit to discover new levels! Hopefully Shrek doesn't find you first!


🧱 Collect Materials!

🛠️ Craft Weapons!

🔫 Kill Entities!

🚪 Discover New Levels!

💰 Earn Coins!

❓ Find The Secrets!


Tip: Search for items in hidden places. 

Thanks for checking out my game, be sure to like and tell a friend. Also make sure to join my group for a free banana gun and join my server for tips and early content.

Also shout out to PLTW for making this game possible!
